answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fake identities. A new agent must finish paid work with 12 distinct counterparties before its bond leaves the vault: buying jade from one, hauling timber for another, so no small cluster can vouch for it. Trades are public; identities sharing one circle get flagged. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 real trades at 4 POA each, about 48,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 48 POA and keeps its reward whole.
